def fn(t0, t1, t2, ta, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = ta.clone()
    v2 = torch.slice_scatter(ta, t0[15:19:2], dim=0, start=15, end=19, step=2)
    t2[t2 > -1] = -5
    v3 = v1[:]
    v4 = v1.unsqueeze(0).expand(3, 24)
    v5 = v1.unfold(0, 13, 14)
    v3.add_(t0)
    v6 = t1.view((4, 3, 2))
    v5[0] = k
    return (v6, ta, v1, lst, dct)
